meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 lsp 系列工具调用语言服务器:检查文件或目录的诊断报错、按位置跳转符号定义、查找引用、列出文档或工作区符号,并在重命名前校验、执行工作区重命名。
howto.when: 当 Codex 需要语言服务器的诊断、定义、引用等能力,或要做重命名安全检查时触发;改完代码后也可以让它在某个文件或目录上查 error 级诊断。

say.text: 用 lsp.diagnostics 检查这个文件的报错
say.note: 编辑后建议只看 error 级别结果

say.text: 帮我跳到这个符号的定义位置
把这个符号重命名，先确认能不能改
say.note: 先跑 prepare_rename,再执行重命名

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can call the lsp tools to ask a language server for diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, and rename checks, returning query results or applying rename edits.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references and other features, or a rename safety check, e.g. after edits.

say_en.note: Error severity is preferred after edits.

say_en.text: Go to the definition at this file, line and character
Rename this symbol, checking it first
